jobs.title: B2B Sales Associate
jobs.description:
The Company:

When it comes to digital communities, The Alliance is leading the way. Product marketing, sales enablement, product-led growth, AI, customer success, CMOs, you name it, we’re home to thriving communities for them all.

With 160,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of events, memberships, and learning products, we help individuals and teams grow faster in their careers. We work with some of the world’s most recognisable companies and pride ourselves on being a high-impact learning partner, not just another events business.

We’re ambitious, we move quickly, and we’re still early in the journey. That means real ownership, a steep learning curve, and plenty of opportunity to shape what comes next.

About the Role

We’re hiring early-career Sales Associates to join our Delegate & Membership sales team, people with energy, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in commercial roles.

This is a junior role by design. You don’t need years of experience, what matters most is how quickly you learn, how well you take feedback, and how comfortable you are being challenged. We’ll teach you how to sell properly: how to prospect, qualify, handle objections, manage a pipeline, and close, all while speaking to senior decision-makers at some of the world’s biggest tech companies.

You’ll sell across our live events, memberships, and learning solutions in markets including London, New York, San Francisco, Las Vegas and beyond. Over time, this role can progress into more senior sales or specialist commercial paths across the business.

This role is not about arriving fully formed, it’s about building and proving confidence, capability, and momentum through doing.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Sales Upskilling: You’ll build strong foundations in prospecting, qualification, pipeline management, and closing, while learning how to sell confidently to senior B2B stakeholders and work to clear targets and expectations.

  • Engaging decision-makers: You’ll speak directly with professionals at fast-growing and enterprise tech companies, understand their challenges, and recommend the right events, memberships, and learning solutions.

  • Owning deals end-to-end: You’ll own your pipeline from first contact through to close and handover, taking accountability for outcomes and using feedback and data to improve week by week.

  • Product mastery: You’ll develop strong knowledge of our events, memberships, and education ecosystem, enabling confident and relevant cross-selling.

  • Collaboration & feedback: You’ll work closely with marketing, product, community, and customer success teams, sharing insights and operating with autonomy while knowing when to ask for support.

This Role Is For You If

  • You’re early in your career and hungry to learn, not entitled to results

  • You’re comfortable being uncomfortable while learning something new

  • You actively seek feedback and apply it quickly

  • You take ownership for outcomes, not just effort

  • You’re resilient, organised, and able to manage pace and pressure

  • You communicate clearly with customers and with teammates

  • You enjoy working as part of a team where success is shared

Our Hiring Process

Our hiring process is designed to reflect how we actually work: collaborative, practical, and focused on potential rather than polish.

  • First interview (values, motivation, and learning mindset)

  • One-day assessment in our London office (practical exercises, collaboration, and real-world sales scenarios)

  • Final shortlist: up to 3 candidates selected into an onboarding cohort, starting together and learning side-by-side

This process helps us understand how you think, learn, and show up — not just how well you interview.

Compensation: Base Salary £26,500 - 28,000 *range depending on experience

Commissions:
Year 1 OTE £35,000 uncapped
Year 2 OTE £55,000 uncapped

_________________________________

Benefits

Time off & flexibility

  • 34 days’ paid holiday including UK Bank holidays and a day off on your birthday

  • Flexible working hours: our core hours are 10am–4:30pm, with the flexibility to structure your working day between 8am and 8pm around when you work best

  • Work from where works for you: choose to work remotely within the UK or hybrid from our London office. Our office is always open to the wider team whenever you fancy coming in

  • WFH Kit: a comprehensive tech setup, plus a dedicated WFH equipment budget

  • A well-stocked office: snacks, drinks and fresh fruit available in our London office

Health & wellbeing

  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance with Bupa

  • Life Insurance: cover worth 4x your annual salary

  • On-demand therapy & coaching: company sponsored access to therapy and career coaching through Spill

  • Wellness perks: discounts on gym memberships, fitness and wellness classes

  • Cycle to Work & Workplace Nursery schemes

  • Perks at Work: access to a wide range of corporate discounts

  • Monthly flexible benefits allowance through ThanksBen (£50/month in year one, £100/month in year two and £165/month from year three), giving you extra flexibility to spend on the benefits that matter most to you

Learning & development

  • A growing personal L&D budget (starting at £500 per year and increasing with tenure to £3,000 per year)

  • Dedicated L&D or volunteering time: one paid day every quarter to invest in your development or support a cause you care about.

  • Unlimited access to our internal Academy: including courses, learning resources and professional certifications

Community and Inclusion

We are committed to creating a workplace that is free from discrimination and bias, and where everyone has equal opportunities to succeed and contribute. We acknowledge that our work here is never done - and we promise to continue striving for inclusivity every day.

If you’re worried you don’t quite hit all the requirements we’ve listed, don’t let that hold you back from submitting your application! Unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are essential for our ability to innovate and grow, so if you think you’d be a great fit then we’d love to hear from you.

We are The Alliance - in more ways than one.

Compensation: £26.5K – £28K • £10K – £20K Commission

jobs.description:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end.

With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Lead. You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team.

What you will own

Day One: Hands-On Frontline Support

  • Frontline Excellence: Personally resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat and phone, delivering high-touch support from day one.

  • Internal Product Mastery: Act as our expert power user, testing our internal OS and advocating for tool improvements that boost operational efficiency.

  • NPS & Proactive Care: Design proactive care initiatives to ensure member satisfaction remains consistently best-in-class.

Post-Ramp: Team Scale & Process

  • Team Scaling & Playbooks: Build, mentor, and lead a growing support team while writing our core SOPs, escalation pathways, and training guides.

  • Cross-Functional Feedback: Turn daily support interactions into structured insights that directly inform product roadmap decisions.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • Experience: 2+ years in high-volume B2C customer care or support, with a track record of mentoring peers and a readiness to step into your first formal lead role.

  • Bilingual Skills: Fluent in both English and French (written and spoken).

  • People-First Energy: You bring genuine warmth, high empathy, and enthusiasm to every interaction, turning routine support into remarkable member experiences.

  • Phone-First Instinct: You default to picking up the phone whenever a complex issue calls for a personal touch.

  • Rigorous Precision: Exceptional attention to detail with zero tolerance for misquotes, incorrect details, or operational errors.

Nice to have

  • Regulated Industry Experience: Prior background in healthtech, fintech, or another high-compliance consumer space where accuracy is critical.

  • Startup Mindset: Thrives in early-stage environments with high autonomy, rapid execution, and clear communication.

  • Modern Tooling: Practical experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and boost support efficiency.

 

The process

  • Intro call, culture & role fit (20 min)

  • Case study interview (30-60 min)

  • Deep dive and team chat, on-site (2 hours)

  • Reference calls

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.

En tant que Business Development Representative chez Amenitiz, vous prenez en charge l'intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact de prospection jusqu'à la signature du contrat. Il ne s'agit pas d'un poste centré uniquement sur la prise de rendez-vous. Vous prospectez, réalisez des démonstrations, traitez les objections et concluez les ventes, tout en gérant votre pipeline et votre contribution au chiffre d'affaires de bout en bout.

Nos clients sont des hôteliers indépendants partout en Europe : des établissements familiaux, des hôtels-boutiques et de petites chaînes hôtelières insuffisamment servis par des solutions technologiques conçues pour les grands groupes. Avec plus de 15 000 clients et une note de satisfaction de 4,8/5, notre produit bénéficie d'une forte reconnaissance sur le marché.

Vous commercialiserez une solution qui a un impact concret et mesurable sur le quotidien de ses utilisateurs, tout en étant pleinement responsable de l'ensemble du processus qui leur permet d'y accéder.

(Ce rôle est basé à Lyon, en France)

Votre mission

  • Prospection et génération de pipeline

  • Identifiez et contactez de nouveaux clients potentiels par téléphone, e-mail et chat. Maintenez un niveau d'activité élevé et construisez un pipeline commercial solide à partir de zéro. Vous êtes responsable de l'ensemble de votre activité de prospection.

  • Découverte des besoins et qualification

  • Comprenez l'organisation actuelle de chaque prospect, ses problématiques et ses besoins opérationnels. Identifiez rapidement les opportunités pertinentes et positionnez Amenitiz de manière précise et adaptée à leur situation.

  • Démonstrations produit

  • Animez des démonstrations structurées et personnalisées qui établissent un lien direct entre les fonctionnalités du produit et les enjeux métier du prospect. Rendez la prise de décision simple et évidente.

  • Gestion des objections et closing

  • Traitez avec assurance les hésitations, les comparaisons avec la concurrence et les objections liées au timing. Créez un sentiment d'urgence lorsque cela est pertinent et sachez demander la signature.

  • Gestion du pipeline

  • Maintenez HubSpot à jour et garantissez la fiabilité des données. Réalisez des prévisions précises et assurez un suivi rigoureux de chaque opportunité.

  • Collaboration

  • Travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables commerciaux et vos collègues afin d'améliorer en continu votre approche. Partagez les retours du marché, les objections récurrentes et les informations concurrentielles pour contribuer à la performance collective.

À propos de vous

  • Vous disposez de 2 à 4 ans d'expérience dans une fonction commerciale (SDR, Account Executive ou poste en cycle de vente complet).

  • Vous êtes de langue maternelle française, italienne, espagnole ou portugaise, et possédez un excellent niveau d'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise pour alterner entre des phases de prospection intensive et des phases de closing au cours d'une même semaine.

  • Vous adoptez une approche structurée de la gestion commerciale : vos prévisions sont fiables et votre suivi est irréprochable.

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

Kraken is the operating system of the future for Utilities. When a utility signs up to use Kraken, they have some big ambitions. They want to; improve customer experience, reduce cost to serve or accelerate growth and innovation. To make this possible at pace, clients need the incredible tech stack that Kraken offers, the ability to improve how they operate and to have a culture that enables them to thrive. 

Clients are increasingly interested in understanding how they can improve not only their customer operations but the business functions, and business units that sit horizontally and vertically to customer operations in retail.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Command Centre (Frontend & UI/UX)
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will build the Command Centre, the screen an operator uses to see what our robots and cameras see, decide in seconds, and task the fleet. Soldiers have already run our console unaided after a short introduction. Next, one operator watches many sites, and tasks robots in plain language instead of drawing routes. That needs an interface built for it.

This role is engineering and design in one. You will shape the flows, prototype them, test them with operators, and ship them in production code, working with our full-stack engineer on the backend and our vision engineers on what the models show.

What You'll Work On

  • Operator interface: live video, site maps, robot positions and alerts in one view that works at 03:00.

  • Alert triage: the flow from alert to decision: evidence, context, confirm or dismiss, dispatch a robot.

  • Tasking by instruction: an interface for telling the fleet what to do in plain language, and seeing how it plans to do it.

  • Design system: components and patterns that keep the product consistent as it grows.

  • Usability: prototype, test with operators, measure, iterate.

  • Performance: real-time streams and many sites without the interface slowing down.

Who We're Looking For

A frontend engineer with real UI/UX craft, who has shipped data-heavy, real-time interfaces that people rely on under pressure.

Your Background

  • 3+ years of frontend engineering with TypeScript and React.

  • Shipped real-time, data-heavy interfaces: maps, video, dashboards or control panels.

  • UI/UX practice: you design flows, prototype in Figma or similar, and run user tests.

  • Comfortable with backend APIs and real-time transport (WebSockets, WebRTC).

  • Accessibility and performance as habits, not afterthoughts.

Nice to Have

  • Control room, mission-critical or security interfaces.

  • Mapping and geospatial libraries (Mapbox, deck.gl or similar).

  • Building a design system from scratch.

  • Defence or regulated customers.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform & Infrastructure (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The product you will work on

The HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment. 


Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform.


The ideal candidate is

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production.


This is a software engineering role first. You will spend your time writing software, either with your own team or embedded with one of the other HOLOPLOT teams: services, controllers, agents, and tooling that provision, configure, observe, and update our systems. Our infrastructure is defined as code and evolves through the same review and release process as the rest of our software. You design the operational side, you build it, and you are on call when it misbehaves in the field.


Your role and responsibilities

You will join the team that owns the platform underneath our installations and connected services, working alongside backend, embedded, and frontend engineers who are organized in cross-functional product teams.


Build the platform

  • Architect and implement services to provision, configure, and manage server fleets across AWS and local clusters.

  • Create control-plane logic for venue systems to ensure consistency, health monitoring, rollout management, and recovery, even during uplink disruptions.

  • Establish end-to-end provisioning workflows for embedded Linux hardware, spanning from initial manufacturing to customer deployment.

  • Enhance update processes to streamline software deployments for active customer installations.

  • Develop APIs and developer tooling that empower engineering teams to independently deploy, observe, and troubleshoot their services.

  • Embed telemetry capabilities into the platform to facilitate remote diagnosis of venue system behavior

  • .

Run what you build

  • Own the AWS infrastructure behind our connected services: remote access, access control, telemetry ingestion, remote backup, secret management, and monitoring. All of it is infrastructure as code.

  • Operate and evolve the on-premises Kubernetes footprint at venues, including air-gapped and intermittently connected installations.

  • Monitor large environments, investigate problems across the software/hardware boundary, and turn each incident into a fix in the code.

  • Be part of a compensated on-call rotation


Set the technical direction

  • Advise and collaborate with product teams on building distributed systems that are scalable, secure, and observable, and review their designs with production reality in mind.

  • Research and introduce tools and technologies where they measurably improve how we build and operate.

  • Contribute back to the open-source projects we depend on, through issues and fixes.


What you need to succeed in this role

  • Several years of professional software engineering experience, most of it spent designing and shipping production systems.

  • Fluency in software engineering as a craft: concurrency, error handling, testing, and designing APIs that other teams build on.

  • Working knowledge of the Kubernetes control plane and the operator/controller pattern, including how clusters behave when they are unhealthy.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS, and a firm belief in infrastructure as code. Terraform and Ansible are what we use today.

  • Comfort across several languages, and the ability to pick up a new one when the problem calls for it. Our platform work is mostly Go and Python, with Rust and C++ elsewhere in the stack.

  • Experience building distributed systems, and a clear understanding of how they fail: partitions, partial rollouts, clock skew, retries, and reconciliation.

  • A good sense for software architecture and maintainability, and the habit of writing code that colleagues can pick up and change.

  • A strong command of Linux, scripting, and automation.

  • Experience instrumenting software for telemetry and using it to answer real questions about running systems.

  • Good judgment about what to automate and what to leave alone.

  • Strong communication skills in English. You can explain a design or a failure clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists.

  • Willingness to take part in compensated on-call and weekend work when installations need it.

  • A can-do mentality, an eye for detail, and the courage to take on problems outside your comfort zone.

  • Experience in using AI for engineering.


Nice to haves

  • Experience with NATS, Prometheus/Thanos, or PostgreSQL in production.

  • Experience with air-gapped or intermittently connected installations.

  • Experience running Kubernetes in production, not only deploying to it.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, device fleet management, or IoT security.

  • Networking depth: multicast at scale, WireGuard, BGP, IPv6.

  • Experience in the audio, broadcast, or live events industry.

jobs.title: Managing Director / Country Head (m/w/d) Deutschland
jobs.description:
Bereit, den Markt zu verändern?

PAIR Finance denkt Inkasso neu: Wir entwickeln die fortschrittlichste KI-Technologie im Forderungsmanagement und haben damit die gesamte Inkassoindustrie nachhaltig verändert. Heute sind wir mit 250+ Mitarbeitenden, 600+ Mandant*innen und Standorten in zehn europäischen Städten europaweit führend im Einsatz von KI im Forderungsmanagement – und erzielen dabei höhere Rückzahlungsquoten, ohne die Kundenbeziehung unserer Mandant*innen zu belasten.

Im Zuge der Ausgliederung entsteht die PAIR Finance Deutschland GmbH als eigenständige operative Gesellschaft für unseren Heimatmarkt. Als Managing Director / Country Head (m/w/d) Deutschland übernimmst du die unternehmerische und vertriebliche Verantwortung für diesen Aufbau: Deutschland ist der am weitesten entwickelte Markt unserer europaweit tätigen Gruppe – deine Aufgabe ist es, ihn weiter zu skalieren, zu professionalisieren und profitabel auszubauen. Du gestaltest die nächste Wachstumsphase der deutschen Gesellschaft aktiv mit. 


Was du bei uns bewegen kannst:

  • Umsatz- und Ergebnisverantwortung für den Standort Deutschland: Du steuerst Vertrieb und Neukundenakquise aktiv, verantwortest Pipeline und Forecast und triffst die zentralen kommerziellen Entscheidungen für den deutschen Markt.
  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Vertriebsstrategie für den deutschen Markt, inklusive Priorisierung unserer Schwerpunktindustrien (E-Commerce, Medien & Entertainment, Banken & Versicherungen, Mobility, Energieversorger) und – in Abstimmung mit der Gruppe – dem Einsatz gezielter Collection-Strategien.
  • Akquise neuer Mandant*innen sowie systematischer Ausbau bestehender Partnerschaften: du trägst die Verantwortung für ambitionierte Neugeschäfts- und Wachstumsziele.
  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines vertriebsstarken, motivierten Teams mit klarer Ziel- und Ergebnisorientierung.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem C-Level der Gruppe und den internationalen Country MDs, um pan-europäische Kunden für PAIR Finance zu gewinnen, Vertriebs-Best-Practices gruppenweit zu teilen und Vertriebsstrategien europaweit auszurollen.
  • Positionierung von PAIR Finance am deutschen Markt zur Unterstützung deiner Vertriebsziele – z. B. durch Pressemitteilungen, eigene Vorträge und Auftritte auf Konferenzen, Messen und Webinaren, sowie Weiterentwicklung der Marketingstrategie und Organisation von Kundenevents.
  • Rechtskonformität am Standort: Sicherstellung in enger Abstimmung mit der zentralen Legal & Compliance-Funktion, die hierfür die fachliche Verantwortung trägt.
Hinweis zum Geschäftsmodell: Unsere Mandant*innen (deine Kunden im Vertrieb) sind ausschließlich Unternehmen – vom E-Commerce-Player bis zum Energieversorger. Die eigentliche Forderungsbearbeitung richtet sich an Endverbraucher*innen (B2C). Dein Vertrieb ist also klassisches Enterprise-B2B-Geschäft. 


Was du dafür mitbringen solltest:

  • Mehrjährige, hochrangige Vertriebsführungserfahrung im B2B-Umfeld mit nachweisbaren Vertriebs- und Wachstumserfolgen (z. B. als Sales Director, Head of Sales oder Country Manager), idealerweise im FinTech-Bereich oder in einem regulierten Umfeld wie Inkasso, Forderungsmanagement oder Financial Services
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge im Aufbau und in der Skalierung von B2B-Vertriebsorganisationen – inklusive Verantwortung für Umsatzziele, Pipeline-Steuerung und Forecasting
  • Belastbares, kommerziell nutzbares Netzwerk zu Entscheider*innen in unseren Schlüsselbranchen (E-Commerce, Medien & Entertainment, Banken & Versicherungen, Mobility, Energieversorger)
  • Hohe Kundenorientierung und ausgeprägte Hands-on-Vertriebsmentalität – du gehst selbst aktiv auf Mandant*innen zu
  • Klare, glaubwürdige und zielgruppengerechte Kommunikation
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und starke analytische Fähigkeiten
  • Echtes Interesse an Technologie und der Anwendung von KI
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
Transparenz, Ownership, Execution, Kundenzentrierung, Innovation und Integrität sind für uns bei PAIR Finance keine Worte, sondern gelebte Praxis. Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen und setzen KI täglich aktiv ein, um effizienter zu arbeiten und jeden Tag ein bisschen erfolgreicher zu sein. Wir suchen Kolleg*innen, die diese Neugier teilen, mit kreativem Denken neue Wege ausprobieren und Lust haben, Dinge anders zu machen. 
Erkennst du dich darin wieder? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und bring deine Vertriebsstärke, Motivation und Persönlichkeit ein. 


Was wir dir bieten:

Culture & Team

  • PAIR Finance zählt zu den am stärksten wachsenden Fintechs in Europa. Wir agieren in einem schnellen, dynamischen Marktumfeld und sind mit einem starken internationalen Team in aktuell 14 Ländern in Europa aktiv
  • Flache Hierarchien mit einer transparenten und wertschätzenden Feedbackkultur
  • Regelmäßige 1:1s, All-Hands & Performance Cycles

Standort, Arbeitsmodell & Benefits

Wachstum & Entwicklung

  • Strukturiertes Onboarding mit klaren Zielen ab dem ersten Tag
  • Fokus auf Ownership, schnelle Lernkurven und echte Entwicklung

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

As Senior Risk Management Specialist, you will help scale and further develop lemon.markets’ Risk Management Framework in a period of growing regulatory expectations, business complexity, and organisational maturity. Sitting within the Risk team and working closely with the Head of Risk, you will take over meaningful responsibilities across multiple risk domains and help ensure our controls, assessments, and governance evolve with the company. Over the next 6 to 12 months, your focus will be on strengthening risk processes across operational and non-financial risk topics, contributing to financial risk topics such as ICAAP and ILAAP, and improving the structure, transparency, and efficiency of our risk tooling and reporting. This role matters because strong, pragmatic risk management is a core enabler of scalable growth in a regulated Brokerage-as-a-Service business. You will work across Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and other stakeholders to turn regulatory and risk requirements into practical, tech-enabled solutions that reduce manual work and improve decision-making. It is a strong opportunity for someone who combines broad risk knowledge with a hands-on mindset and wants to help build a mature framework in a fast-moving environment.

In this role you will:

  • Drive risk assessments, control testing, and issue remediation tracking with teams across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Compliance, so we can detect weaknesses early, strengthen controls, and follow through on corrective actions.

You’ll be successful in this role if you:

jobs.title: Founding Customer Support Engineer
jobs.description:
The mission:

comstruct is building the agentic workforce for European construction. Our agents turn paper delivery notes, fragmented invoices and offline supplier decisions into structured, real-time data and live decisions, embedded inside the largest contractors in Europe and the US. To accelerate this journey, we secured a €12.5M seed financing round from 20VC and Google Ventures, along with top European investors.

comstruct builds AI agents for construction. Our platform automates the entire flow from the bill of quantities to the fully verified invoice: RFQs and supplier matching, bid comparison and negotiation, framework contracts and orders, digital delivery notes, invoice verification and sustainability reporting. We're looking for exceptional talent to help us bring this to an industry that still runs most of it by hand.

About the role 🦺

As our Founding Customer Support Engineer you own what happens after go-live: you keep our customers' integrations running and their teams using comstruct every day.

When a delivery note doesn't map to the right project, a 3-way match fails, or data stops flowing from a customer's SAP, you own the problem end to end. You dig into logs, APIs, and data flows to find the root cause, prepare and ship smaller pull requests yourself, and work closely with engineering on more complex fixes. When you're not deep in a technical problem, you're on calls with customers, making sure the teams that went live keep using comstruct in their daily work.

You're the person the customer calls when something breaks and the one who makes sure it doesn't break again. Inside comstruct you're the voice of the customer: you spot the feature gaps that surface in real use and prioritize with the Product Engineering team which ones get built.

The deeper you get into how the product works and where it falls short, the more the door opens to move into a Forward Deployed Engineer or Product Engineering role and ship those fixes and features yourself.

What you will be building 🏗️

  • Own inquiries end-to-end: Our customers run some of the largest construction sites in Europe. When something breaks, it's real: trucks, deliveries, invoices, deadlines.

  • Automate support with our own agents: We sell AI agents; support is a function where we also deploy them internally. You'll work out which parts of the flow an agent can handle and where the human touch still wins.

  • Ship the fix when it's yours to ship: Small PRs, config and mapping changes, data repair scripts, clearer error handling. Reviewed by engineering, shipped by you.

  • Kill recurring issues: Every ticket is a data point. You spot the patterns, bring them to Product Engineering with evidence, and push for the change that makes that ticket class disappear.

  • Build the support foundation: Playbook, macros, help center, internal runbooks. You won't inherit a finished system. You'll write the first version of it as you learn, with the founders and engineering behind you.

  • Report what matters: Time to first response, time to resolution on integration breaks, and how many recurring issue classes you eliminated. You consistently share where we stand with Customer Value Engineers and the wider team.

What we’re looking for ✨

  • 1 - 2 years in a technical, customer-facing role: Customer Success or Support Engineer, Solution Engineer, Implementation, TAM or similar.

  • You're comfortable in APIs, logs, SQL and data flows and can debug across systems you didn't build. You know when an issue is the integration, the data or the product.

  • You can explain a failed integration to an engineer and to a non-technical customer stakeholder, and both walk away clear.

  • You want to understand how the product works under the hood instead of treating it as a black box.

  • You are willing to work five days a week from our Munich office with occasional customer travel.

  • You are native in German and fluent in English.

Nice to have: Ideally, you have initial experience with Construction Tech, Supply Chain or Logistics SaaS experience; early-stage startup experience (<50 employees) where you built processes from scratch.

What we offer

  • A path into building: This role is a launchpad. As you learn how customers use the product and where it breaks, you can grow into a Forward Deployed Engineer or Product Engineering role and build the fixes and features yourself.

  • Real ownership, twice over: Equity options on top of a competitive salary and the freedom to own your work and build things from the ground up, not execute someone else's plan.

  • Learn from the best: Direct mentoring from our Co-founder & CTO Dominik Brosch, plus access to engineering mentors through our network with Google Ventures and 20VC.

  • Build at the frontier: Early access to the latest LLMs and SDKs, any AI productivity tools you need and top-notch hardware.

  • Invest in yourself: A dedicated development budget for certificates, conferences and everything that makes you grow with the company.

  • Feel at home: Relocation support for your move to Munich, daily dinner options with the team, Wellpass subscription and yearly offsites - the last ones took us to Mallorca, Italy and Portugal.

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. The role:

Selling online as a software business is a complex process and many components need to work seamlessly to capture revenue and deliver this to sellers. Paddle manages payments so that we can take this burden from our customers. We process millions of payments globally and make thousands of payouts across multiple balance currencies every month. We do all this while ensuring we’re applying and remitting taxes accurately in all jurisdictions.

As the Engineering Manager of our Subscriptions team, you'll lead the product at the core of Paddle's recurring revenue engine, giving our customers the tools to manage the full subscription lifecycle; from plan changes, upgrades and downgrades to proration, trials and flexible billing schedules. You will be instrumental in helping scale and shape the direction of a product that powers the recurring billing operations of thousands of companies each month.

Each Product Engineering team at Paddle is made up of a Product Manager, Engineering Manager and between 4 - 6 engineers. The teams are set up with a clear area of product ownership along with goals that give them clarity on who they’re building for and the tools to choose how best to do that.   • Help to continuously improve the reliability and scalability of Paddle’s high-traffic event-driven system.

  • Work with our other leaders across Engineering, contributing to the department's engineering principles and practices to build an industry-leading organisation.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. jobs.title: Staff Engineer (f/m/d) AI
jobs.description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

Your Mission at plancraft

We're building plancraft towards an agentic-first product experience. That means AI-enabled capabilities our customers actually use: features that take real administrative work off a tradesperson's plate and hold up under production load, day after day.

Building AI-enabled products that work reliably at scale requires strong engineering foundations. You'll help shape those foundations — from architecture and system design to engineering practices — while keeping the focus on what we're ultimately building for our customers.

This is an individual contributor role with no disciplinary leadership but significant influence across Engineering. You'll work hands-on where it matters, shape technical direction across teams, and help other engineers build better systems.

We have a clear vision for how we want to build software and the outcomes we want to achieve, while recognising that we're still on the journey to get there. Some foundations are already in place; others are still evolving. We're looking for someone who has built and scaled complex systems before and can bring that experience into what we build.

Our customers are tradespeople. Every hour they spend on paperwork is an hour off the job site. We keep that in mind when making technical decisions: the systems we build should ultimately help us take more work off their plate.

Your Responsibilities

  • AI-enabled product capabilities. You'll help define what AI can meaningfully do for our customers and turn emerging capabilities into reliable, observable product experiences that work beyond the demo.

  • The wider technical system. Together with our other Staff Engineers, you'll shape architectural direction and the properties that should hold across teams, while enabling individual teams to build and ship independently.

  • Data foundations for AI-enabled workflows. You’ll help turn product and business data into meaningful signals, insights, and context that AI can use reliably in customer-facing workflows — from defining the right data models and semantics, and drawing a clear line between operational data and knowledge, to making that understanding available where it creates real product value.

  • How we build with AI. You'll influence both how we develop and evaluate customer-facing AI capabilities and how AI changes software engineering itself — from tooling and workflows to standards and practices across the organisation.

How you'll work & influence

We have clear engineering principles, but we expect our Staff Engineers to challenge and evolve them. We favour small, integrated changes, observable systems that recover quickly, explicit architectural boundaries, and engineering decisions that are encoded rather than repeatedly debated. Above all, engineers own customer problems — not tickets.

You'll have meaningful autonomy from the start:

  • Shape technical direction. You'll evolve shared architecture and engineering standards through RFCs and ADRs, not by waiting for top-down decisions.

  • Own complex initiatives end to end. From discovery and technical design through implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • Influence where Engineering invests. You'll help identify the technical capabilities, architectural improvements, and engineering practices worth investing in.

  • Raise the bar across teams. You'll shape architecture, developer experience, AI-enabled engineering practices, and codebase quality beyond your immediate team.

  • Multiply other engineers. You'll mentor through collaboration, architectural guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

How hands-on you are depends on the problem. Some weeks you'll be deep in the code; others you'll focus on system design, technical discovery, or mentoring across teams. We care about the technical outcomes you create, not your commit count.

Your Profile

  • AI- and agentic-build competencies. You have designed, built, shipped, or operated AI-enabled or agentic product systems beyond prompts alone: retrieval and knowledge design, evaluation of non-deterministic behaviour, observability of model- and tool-driven flows, and debugging across multi-step agent traces. You know what it takes to move these systems from promising demos into reliable product experiences, and you can help others build the judgement to use them safely.

  • Experience building and operating real production systems. You've designed, shipped, and lived with complex systems at scale — whether distributed architectures, asynchronous or multi-step workflows, event-driven services, data pipelines, or ETL pipelines. You understand reliability and observability because you've needed them in practice. You bring 5+ years of software engineering experience and a track record of technical leadership.

  • Strong typed-language fundamentals — and a polyglot mindset. You understand the concepts that make a strong type system valuable and use them to keep a growing codebase understandable and maintainable. Our stack is React on the frontend, serverless Node.js / Express on the backend, and GCP underneath — all TypeScript, so you're either productive in TypeScript or able to get there quickly. Where your deepest expertise sits matters less: if that's Rust, Go, Kotlin, or something else, we see it as a strength. Having worked across several languages and paradigms tends to reduce stack bias exactly when systems thinking matters most. Experience with another modern cloud environment is absolutely fine.

  • Information systems thinking. You distinguish clearly between operational data and knowledge — the transactional state that runs the business versus the modelled, contextual understanding that AI-enabled workflows depend on — and you design deliberately for both. In an agentic product, that distinction is a practical necessity, not a theoretical one.

  • Strong system design and domain modelling skills. You know how to create clear boundaries, model business concepts explicitly, and design systems that can evolve without every change becoming expensive. Techniques such as dependency injection, adapters, making invalid states unrepresentable, and parse-don’t-validate are tools you’ve applied rather than concepts you’ve only read about.

  • Strong product thinking. You start with the problem rather than the technology, use evidence to understand customer needs, and make deliberate trade-offs between technical excellence, speed, and product outcomes.

  • Technical leadership beyond your own work. You've influenced technical direction across teams, mentored other engineers, and can align Engineering, Product, and business stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

  • AI is already part of how you work. You use tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or Codex seriously, understand where they help and where they don't, and can help others adopt them effectively.

  • A T-shaped engineering profile. You bring broad engineering judgment across product and system challenges, with genuine depth in at least one area.

  • C1 English. German is a plus, not a must.

Deep production engineering experience and the ability to apply it to AI-enabled products matter more than expertise in a specific model or framework.

Who this role is for

This role is for someone who wants to operate as a senior individual contributor with broad technical influence — without people management. You won’t be the only Staff Engineer: we currently have four Staff Engineers and are looking for great additions to the group. You’ll work closely with Engineering Managers who steward people, team environment and flow while you steward the technical system and direction.

You’ll enjoy this role if you like moving across product, architecture, engineering practices and AI-enabled ways of working — and if you prefer shaping systems and standards across teams over specialising deeply in one narrow technology or domain.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

______

On the application process
We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here. If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

Note on creating a test account:
If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily.

jobs.description:
ABOUT US

METYCLE: where innovation meets sustainability
We are reshaping the global secondary metals industry to accelerate the circular flow of metals. By combining global trading, advanced processing and digital intelligence, we make secondary metals more predictable, transparent and scalable, strengthening industrial supply chains and reducing reliance on primary metal production.
And the impact is significant: recycling aluminium can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 95% compared with primary aluminium production.
And we take it further! Our SmartSorting Hubs combine advanced sorting technology, automation and AI to transform how complex scrap is processed, turning selected mixed streams into better-defined industrial feedstock while improving material quality and traceability.Join us at a defining stage as we bring the $600 billion scrap metals industry into the 21st century and build a new global standard for secondary metals.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes.
This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business.
Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • Analytics & Insights: Turn complex business questions into clear, actionable analysis, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and the key drivers behind business performance. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions.
  • Data Foundations: Build and maintain the data transformations needed to turn raw data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets in the Data Warehouse. Work hands-on with imperfect data, validate its accuracy and meaning, and identify gaps or inconsistencies in how data is captured.
  • Data Modelling: Translate business requirements into well-structured, reusable data models and clearly defined metrics that provide a trusted source of truth for analytics across the organisation.
  • Data Quality: Implement and maintain data quality checks and tests to ensure data is accurate, consistent, complete, and fresh - proactively identifying and resolving issues with relevant stakeholders and working with Engineering to improve how underlying data is captured.
  • Reporting & Self-Service: Build and support dashboards, reports, and analytical datasets that are intuitive, performant, and optimised for internal reporting and self-service analytics. Help turn recurring analytical needs and ad-hoc analysis into stable, scalable, and increasingly automated reporting.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Product, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Engineering, and other teams to understand business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate them into meaningful analytical questions and solutions. Communicate effectively across different levels and functions, from discussing detailed data questions with technical teams to presenting clear insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Documentation & Standards: Maintain clear documentation for datasets, transformations, metrics, and data lineage using dbt Docs or similar tools, and contribute to practical standards for SQL, data modelling, testing, and visualisation.
  • Automation & AI: Identify manual or inefficient analytical workflows and improve them through automation, modern data tooling, and AI-assisted analysis - using AI to accelerate data exploration, querying, documentation, and reporting while maintaining a strong understanding of and control over the underlying data.


YOUR PROFILE

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, Business Analytics, or a closely related analytical role, with a track record of turning complex business questions and raw data into reliable analysis, actionable insights, and business decisions
  • Strong analytical and statistical thinking, with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, and root causes, define meaningful metrics, challenge assumptions, and work confidently with imperfect or incomplete data
  • Independent, structured, and pragmatic, with a strong sense of ownership. You are equally comfortable working with business stakeholders and engineers, communicate clearly across different levels and functions, and can bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You are also genuinely curious about AI-assisted analytics and modern cloud data workflows, while maintaining full control of and understanding of the underlying data
  • Strong business understanding and analytical curiosity, with the ability to quickly grasp the essentials of a complex, finance-driven business, understand how the underlying processes work, and translate business needs into meaningful analytical questions. Experience with financials, commodity trading, finance analytics, or accounting is a strong advantage
  • Strong SQL skills with experience working with complex datasets, data transformations, joins, aggregations, window functions, and analytical data models
  • Proven experience working with modern Data Warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, or similar, including building and maintaining clean, reliable datasets for analysis and reporting
  • Experience with modern analytics engineering practices and tools such as dbt, including data modelling, automated data quality tests, documentation, and data lineage
  • Strong experience with BI and visualisation tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI or similar), with a focus on building clear, performant dashboards and enabling self-service analytics


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities

Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the latest — Privacy Pro. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work — you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Web Dependability Engineering team, you'll make sure websites just work in DuckDuckGo's browsers across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, helping ensure our users have the best-possible experience browsing with DuckDuckGo. Recent projects include:

  • Reverse-engineering how sites detect our privacy protections and building countermeasures that keep pages working

  • Building LLM agent pipelines that automatically reproduce and triage reported site breakage

jobs.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission


You will be the operational backbone of Alta Ares' field demonstration team — ensuring that every client and partner demonstration runs flawlessly, from equipment preparation through to mission debrief.


On the ground, you are the go-to support for pilots, operators, and engineers: handling logistics, setting up and dismantling demo sites, keeping the equipment fleet in condition, and solving problems on the fly. Your versatility and resourcefulness set you apart — you move seamlessly from a hardware check to a client interaction, from a flight case to a transport declaration, without losing pace or precision.

Key Responsibilities

Demonstration Preparation

  • Prepare and verify all equipment before each mission: drones, ground control stations, batteries, and tooling

  • Pack into flight cases and conduct pre-departure checks

  • Keep inventories accurate and up to date

Checklists & Continuous Improvement

  • Own the operational and equipment checklists — execute them on the day

  • Update checklists after each mission based on field feedback

  • Formalise and improve processes continuously

Logistics & Transport

  • Organise outbound shipments and equipment returns

  • Prepare all transport documentation and coordinate with carriers and the supply chain

  • Ensure material arrives on time and in compliance with applicable regulations, including for sensitive or dual-use equipment

Field Deployment

  • Install and strike the demonstration site

  • Support pilots during flight operations

  • Serve as the on-site point of contact for ground teams, host nation staff, and client representatives

Equipment Maintenance

  • Monitor the condition of the demonstration fleet and report anomalies

  • Carry out first-level maintenance interventions

  • Keep the hardware mission-ready at all times

Administrative Support

  • Prepare authorisation requests and write mission reports

  • Manage expense claims and travel bookings

  • Keep tracking tools up to date: backlog, planning, and mission logs


Candidate Profile

  • Military background or defence sector experience strongly valued: logistics, field support, or operations

  • Understanding of the defence ecosystem required — genuine commitment to national and European sovereignty

  • Versatile and resourceful: you move from a manual handling task to a client conversation without missing a beat

  • Rigorous on equipment and procedures — with the instinct to formalise and improve what can be

  • Comfortable working independently and as part of a team

  • Available for frequent travel, including internationally and in degraded security environments, sometimes at short notice

  • Professional English — mandatory

  • French driving licence (Permis B) — mandatory; heavy goods licence (Poids Lourd) appreciated

  • Good physical condition — outdoor work and load carrying are part of the role

  • Experience in drone piloting or the UAS/C-UAS ecosystem is a plus

  • Experience shipping sensitive equipment is a plus

jobs.description:
Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr.

Vous êtes rattaché(e) au Centre des Matériaux des Mines Alès (C2MA) de l'IMT Mines Alès et dans l'équipe de recherche : UMR LMGC "Laboratoire de Mécanique et Génie Civil".

En tant que Maître de Conférences de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, vous réalisez des tâches d’enseignement, de recherche et de transfert technologique.

Activités d'enseignement

  • Participer aux activités d’enseignements de l’école du département Génie Civil et Bâtiment Durable (GCBD), dans les filières Infrastructures et Grands Ouvrages (IGO), Bâtiment et Energie (BE), et Bâtiment (BAT), sous forme de cours magistraux, travaux dirigés, travaux pratiques, encadrement de projets et tutorat d'étudiants ;

  • Assurer des enseignements dans les domaines du génie civil, des matériaux et du calcul des structures ;

  • Dispenser des enseignements en anglais ou développer des méthodes de pédagogie active ;

  • Participer aux jurys de recrutement des élèves et aux actions de promotion de la formation d’ingénieurs ;

  • Piloter une spécialisation en dernière année d’études et proposer des missions de recherche et développement ;

  • Assurer un volume minimal de 150 heures d'enseignement par an.

Activités de recherche

  • Mener des activités de recherche au sein de l'axe « Milieux divisés » du LMGC ;

  • Renforcer la thématique sur les matrices cimentaires bas carbone, en lien avec les propriétés macroscopiques et la durabilité de ces matériaux, et fédérer d’autres chercheurs en faisant le lien avec les aspects modélisation et mécaniques développées au LMGC ;

  • S’intéresser aux méthodes de caractérisation expérimentale des propriétés des matériaux cimentaires de l’état frais et à l’état durci en particulier de la microstructure nécessitant des connaissances en physico-chimie des matrices cimentaires et sur l’adjuvantation ;

  • Contribuer à la gestion collective de la plateforme Génie-Civil.

Activités de valorisation et de transfert technologique

  • Rechercher et monter des contrats de recherche avec des partenaires industriels et académiques ainsi que rédiger des dossiers de demande de financements auprès d’organismes publics ou de programmes internationaux ;

  • Assurer l'interface avec le partenaire contractuel, prendre en charge les objectifs scientifiques définis dans le projet, animer une équipe projet et assurer le suivi de son déroulement, ainsi que la communication afférente ;

  • Développer une compréhension du processus d’exploitation commerciale de résultats de recherche afin de contribuer à la coopération entre la recherche académique, la recherche industrielle et les secteurs de production.

  • Réaliser, dans son champ de compétences scientifiques et techniques, des actions destinées à accompagner des entreprises ou l’incubateur de l’école afin de favoriser la création de spin off et le développement d’entreprises technologiques.

Vous trouvez plus d’information sur le descriptif du poste ici :

https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/Zqr5eBT6ijzic9y


Le poste requiert une expérience confirmée en enseignement du génie civil et des matériaux de construction, ainsi qu’une aptitude à concevoir et mettre en œuvre des pédagogies innovantes adaptées aux compétences visées. Vous devrez disposer d’une expérience solide en recherche, démontrer votre capacité à développer des collaborations scientifiques, à publier vos travaux et à valoriser les résultats de recherche auprès de partenaires académiques et industriels. La maîtrise de l’anglais scientifique est requise ; une expérience internationale et une capacité à vous intégrer aux projets du LMGC et du C2MA constitueront des atouts.

jobs.title: Post-doctorant·e en apprentissage décentralisé sûr, conficentiel et explicable - CDD 12 mois
jobs.description:
Présentation de Télécom SudParis :

Télécom SudParis est une grande école publique d'ingénieurs reconnue au meilleur niveau des sciences et technologies du numérique. La qualité de ses formations est basée sur l’excellence scientifique de son corps professoral et une pédagogie mettant l’accent sur les projets d’équipes, l’innovation de rupture et l’entreprenariat. Télécom SudParis compte 1 000 étudiantes et étudiants dont 700 élèves ingénieurs et environ de 150 doctorantes et doctorants. Télécom SudParis fait partie de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’école d’ingénieurs en France, et partage son campus avec Institut Mines-Télécom Business School. Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis

À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :

L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom

Missions

  • Analyser les enjeux de sécurité, de vie privée et d’éthique liés au déploiement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle (IA) dans des domaines critiques et variés, notamment la santé, la finance et les transports.

  • Étudier les méthodes d’apprentissage automatique préservant la vie privée (Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning – PPML) et leur capacité à répondre aux exigences réglementaires et éthiques, notamment celles découlant du RGPD et de l’AI Act.

  • Concevoir et évaluer des approches de protection de la vie privée dans des environnements d’apprentissage décentralisé, en particulier dans le cadre de l’apprentissage fédéré.

  • Identifier et caractériser les vulnérabilités de sécurité propres à l’apprentissage collaboratif et fédéré, notamment les attaques par empoisonnement de données, l’injection de portes dérobées (backdoors) et les attaques visant la confidentialité des données et des utilisateurs.

  • Étudier les mécanismes d’inférence à partir des mises à jour de modèles, notamment les attaques par inférence d’appartenance et par inférence de propriétés, afin d’évaluer les risques de divulgation d’informations sensibles.

  • Évaluer la robustesse et la confidentialité des modèles d’IA dans des contextes où les données, les nœuds et les processus d’apprentissage sont distribués et difficilement auditables.

  • Étudier les méthodes d’intelligence artificielle explicable (XAI) afin d’améliorer la transparence, l’interprétabilité et la compréhension des décisions produites par les modèles d’IA.

  • Analyser les interactions et compromis entre explicabilité, vie privée et robustesse dans les systèmes d’apprentissage décentralisé.

  • Développer et expérimenter des méthodes permettant de concilier transparence et protection de la vie privée, en tenant compte des contraintes propres aux environnements distribués.

  • Mettre en place des protocoles expérimentaux et des critères d’évaluation permettant de mesurer les niveaux de confidentialité, de robustesse et d’explicabilité des approches étudiées.

  • Contribuer à la valorisation et à la diffusion des résultats de recherche, notamment par la rédaction de publications scientifiques, la présentation des travaux dans des conférences et la participation aux échanges avec les partenaires du projet.

  • Assurer une veille scientifique et technologique sur les avancées en IA de confiance,

Activités

  • Concevoir et développer des mécanismes d’apprentissage décentralisé offrant de fortes garanties de confidentialité, une résistance aux comportements malveillants et des capacités d’explicabilité pertinentes.

  • Étudier la confidentialité des mécanismes d’explicabilité, en particulier les risques de fuite d’informations susceptibles d’être induits par les méthodes d’explicabilité appliquées aux modèles d’apprentissage fédéré.

  • Développer de nouvelles stratégies d’attaque et d’évaluation permettant de caractériser les informations susceptibles d’être divulguées par les mécanismes d’explicabilité.

  • Concevoir des mécanismes de protection adaptés permettant de limiter les fuites d’informations identifiées tout en préservant la qualité et la pertinence des explications produites.

  • Développer des approches d’apprentissage collaboratif conciliant confidentialité et explicabilité, en tenant compte des contraintes propres aux environnements fédérés et décentralisés.

  • Étudier l’utilisation de la confidentialité différentielle (Differential Privacy – DP) pour protéger les modèles agrégés contre les attaques par inférence et analyser son impact sur la qualité et la fidélité des explications.

  • Explorer des primitives cryptographiques adaptées à l’apprentissage fédéré, notamment le chiffrement partiellement ou totalement homomorphe et les techniques de calcul multipartite sécurisé (Secure Multi-Party Computation – MPC).

  • Combiner les mécanismes cryptographiques et la confidentialité différentielle afin d’explorer des compromis entre niveau de confidentialité, qualité des explications, coût de calcul et éventuelles fuites d’information.

  • Étudier l’impact des mécanismes de protection de la vie privée sur les méthodes d’explicabilité, notamment les méthodes fondées sur l’attribution, et identifier des stratégies permettant de préserver leur fidélité.

  • Analyser les vulnérabilités des systèmes d’apprentissage fédéré face aux attaques byzantines et aux attaques par empoisonnement, en particulier lorsque les stratégies adverses exploitent des métriques ou informations issues de l’explicabilité.

  • Étudier des scénarios d’attaque réalistes prenant en compte l’hétérogénéité et le déséquilibre des données détenues par les différents clients, l’empoisonnement des étiquettes (label poisoning) et la présence de clients associés à des attributs protégés.

  • Développer des algorithmes d’agrégation robustes et préservant la vie privée, capables de maintenir les performances du modèle dans des environnements comportant une proportion importante de participants malveillants.

  • Concevoir des mécanismes de défense adaptatifs exploitant l’explicabilité, notamment pour identifier les comportements anormaux, les mises à jour suspectes ou les participants potentiellement malveillants.

  • Analyser conjointement les compromis entre vie privée, robustesse, explicabilité et utilité du modèle, en intégrant également les contraintes liées à l’efficacité computationnelle et aux communications.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - Industrialization
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 190 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. We are open to internships all year round and post regularly.
 
We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join our mission.
 
This is your chance to collaborate with world-class experts, gain real-world experience, and make meaningful contributions in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary environment.
 
 

The Opportunity

You will join the Industrialization team, the group that turns ANYmal from something engineers can build into something a factory can build, test, and release at volume. Every robot that leaves our production line passes through the test systems this team owns. When those tests are effective, quality issues are caught in Zurich before reaching a customer's industrial site. That is the leverage of this role.Sitting directly at the intersection of software and hardware, you will write Python code to interface with physical devices, help define reliable pass/fail criteria for ANYmal subsystems, and deploy test routines to our manufacturing shopfloor. Working alongside Manufacturing Engineers, test technicians, and hardware design teams, you will gain hands-on experience bridging cutting-edge robotics design with scalable industrial production.
 
 

The Market & Our Technology


ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Founded as an ETH Zurich spin-off, we build autonomous mobile robots (ANYmal) that solve complex inspection tasks in challenging industrial environments such as energy, chemical, and mining facilities. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people in Zurich and work on cutting-edge robot technology that is transforming industrial operations globally.

Your Impact
  • Develop, test, and help deploy Python-based automated test procedures for ANYmal hardware subsystems
  • Instrument and control hardware devices, sensors, and cameras directly through software interfaces
  • Collaborate with test technicians and manufacturing engineers to refine shopfloor testing workflows
  • Learn to write clean, resilient, and reproducible code using established software engineering best practices
  • Contribute directly to test documentation and technician procedures to ensure seamless shopfloor execution

    • Your Profile
  • Ongoing or recently completed degree (BSc or MSc) in Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering
  • Solid Python programming foundation with experience building projects that interact with hardware, sensors, or external APIs
  • Practical hands-on experience with hardware interfaces through university labs, student projects, or personal builds
  • Structured approach to problem-solving and a keen interest in measurement fundamentals like tolerances and repeatability
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, comfortable explaining technical concepts and drafting structured procedures
  • Proactive mindset with a desire to learn quickly, ask questions early, and work in a hands-on production environment
  • Based in or willing to relocate to Zurich, with a commitment to regular on-site presence near the hardware and shopfloor

    • Bonus Points
  • Experience with ROS or ROS2
  • Basic understanding of image processing or computer vision pipelines (OpenCV)
  • Exposure to sensor calibration techniques (IMU, camera intrinsics/extrinsics, depth, or thermal)
  • Familiarity with Docker or devcontainer environments
  • Background in student engineering teams such as Formula Student, Swissloop, or ARIS Rocketry, especially on testing or integration

    Start date: any time of the year and always on the 1st of the month

    Workload: 100% (Full time, Onsite)

    Must be enrolled in a University

    - Hands-on experience working on advanced locomotion software.
    - Mentorship from industry experts.
    - Opportunities to contribute to innovative projects.
    - A dynamic and collaborative work environment.
    - Potential for future full-time opportunities.
     
    We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive and fun environment in the city of Zurich.
